faqs.question: What makes The Pawlour different from other grooming salons?
faqs.answer: We are cage-free: your pet waits and dries in an open room rather than a crate. Our groomers are SKC-certified and trained in low-stress handling, and we book fewer pets per day so nobody is rushed.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: Basic Grooming, Full Grooming, and spa treatments such as the Microbubble and Ayurvedic Herb spas. Add-ons include teeth brushing, de-shedding, mud mask therapy and flea & tick treatment.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Message us on WhatsApp with your pet's breed and the day you have in mind, and we will confirm a slot. You can also call us during opening hours.

faqs.question: How should I prepare my pet for grooming?
faqs.answer: A light meal two to three hours before, and a toilet break just before you arrive. Tell us about any skin conditions, injuries, or handling sensitivities when you book so we can plan the session.

faqs.question: Are your products safe for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use hypoallergenic products and match the shampoo and conditioner to your pet's coat and skin. Let us know about allergies at booking and we will adjust.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We ask for 24 hours' notice. Cancellations inside 24 hours may be charged 50% of the service. Tell us as early as you can if something comes up and we will do our best to move things around.

faqs.question: How often should my pet be groomed?
faqs.answer: Most coats do well on a four to eight week cycle, though it depends on breed and coat type. We will suggest a schedule for your pet after the first visit.

faqs.question: Do you offer mobile grooming?
faqs.answer: Not at the moment. All grooming happens at our Hougang salon. Message us if you would like to be told when that changes.
